$comment: Sites isc-ai offers in 'isc-ai config from-ccr'. Namespaces, roles and links are read from
the CCR portal every time; only what the portal gets wrong for the IRIS REST API lives here:
host_aliases (portal IP -> DNS name its certificate covers) and endpoints (planned server id
-> URL, for a load-balancer link without /api/atelier). System codes verified against the
portal on 2026-10-19; ACHS fixes verified with a read-only connection the same day.
Add your own in ~/.isc-ai/ccr-sites.json with the same shape; a site there replaces the one here.
